howToPlay:
HOW TO PLAY
TRIPLE TWIST
Step 1,
Pick Your Numbers

Choose Quick Pick and let the computer select the numbers for you, or select your own six numbers (1 – 42). Automatically receive two additional rows of six numbers randomly selected by the computer.

Step 2,
Buy Your Ticket

Triple Twist tickets cost $2 per game and can be purchased*** at more than 3,000 Arizona Lottery Retailers.

Step 3,
Check Your Winnings

After the drawing occurs, match your numbers to the numbers selected**** in the drawing to win cash prizes.
